notes: Arduino Yún is not in the catalogue, so it is a new type arduino-yun with Uno-style header port names.
Breadboard strips are the horizontal 5-hole groups in the image, mapped to top-bank columns 5, 8 and 9 (arbitrary column choice, relative spacing kept from the image).
Red wire goes from pin 9 to strip 5t, where R1 pin 1 sits. R1 spans to strip 9t (the bottom row in the image), where the LED anode sits.
LED cathode shares strip 8t with the black wire, which goes to the GND header pin (GND.1) beside the power header.
This matches the schematic: D9 -> R1 (220 ohm) -> LED1 -> GND.
The Yún being on a wireless network, the USB power and the sketch are not modelled as parts.
